title: Report of the Secretary of State of the State of Indiana for the year ending October 31, 1880: Official Vote of the State of Indiana at the October and November Elections, 1880 (fold-out sheet)

pages.hint: Counties down the left, one row per county in the order printed, ending with the Totals row. This is one fold-out sheet with many columns; read only the named columns, counted from the left of the table (not the county names): the first three columns, under 'For Governor.' (Albert G. Porter, Franklin Landers, Richard Gregg). Ignore the Lieutenant Governor columns.

Counties down the left, one row per county in the order printed, ending with the Totals row. This is one fold-out sheet with many columns; read only the named columns, counted from the left of the table (not the county names): the last three columns, under 'For President.' (James A. Garfield, Winfield S. Hancock, James B. Weaver); ignore every column to their left.

note: Leaves 136-137 are Internet Archive page indexes of the fold-out; leaf 136 holds the whole table and leaf 137 only the clipped left margin. The October governor election and the November presidential election are both dated 1880-11-02 as the archive dates the contests.
